name: _structure.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  _structure.scss — the runtime design system.
//  Publishes every SCSS token as a CSS custom property on :root (+ the
//  html.dark-mode overrides and the skeleton/theme surface tokens). This file
//  is THE layer where $ vars become var()s — component stylesheets must read
//  the vars, never the $ tokens. Also defines the reset, the global skeleton
//  shimmer keyframes (pure CSS animation — no JS loop), the genie dialog
//  transform-origin contract (--genie-x/--genie-y), and the z-index scale.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Publish every design token as CSS custom properties — the ONLY place $ vars become var()s.
:root {
  // Base raw colors
  --color-white-raw: #{$color-white};
  --color-black-raw: #{$color-black};
  --color-grey-raw: #{$color-grey};
  --color-grey-2-raw: #{$color-grey-2};
  --color-grey-3-raw: #{$color-grey-3};
  --color-blue-raw: #{$color-blue};

  // CMS brand tokens — exposed as CSS vars so component SCSS files can use them
  // without referencing $cms-* SCSS variables (which are _structure.scss-only).
  --color-accent: #{$cms-accent};
  --color-accent-hover: #{$cms-accent-hover};
  --color-accent-contrast: #{$cms-accent-contrast};
  // Keyboard focus ring ink — tracks the theme-aware control accent
  // (deep teal in light mode, signature cyan in dark via the override
  // below), so Tab affordance matches the project palette in both themes.
  --focus-ring: var(--color-accent-contrast);
  --bg-darkest: #{$cms-bg-darkest};

  // Light theme default tokens
  --bg-primary: #ffffff;
  --bg-secondary: #f7f7f7;
  --bg-dark: #262626; // Current dark areas in light mode
  --bg-darker: #161616; // Deep black blocks in light mode
  --text-primary: #262626; // Main text
  --text-secondary: #515151; // Muted text
  --text-muted: #545454; // 7:1 on white AND --bg-secondary (WCAG AAA)
  // Muted ink for always-dark surfaces (contact band, modals, photo
  // overlays, loaders): 7.6:1 on --bg-dark in both themes.
  --text-muted-on-dark: #b8b8b8;
  --border-color: #e2e2e2;
  --border-item: transparent;
  --border-item-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  --border-item-featured: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  --btn-accent-fill: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);

  // Fullscreen menu — light mode reads as water: pale foam surface with
  // deep→light blue inks feeding the contour-field shader and items.
  --menu-bg: #eaf4f9;
  --menu-ink: #0f5270; // 7.6:1 on --menu-bg — AAA for the small menu labels too
  --menu-ink-2: #5cb9d8;

  // Animated page backdrop (light theme) — two oversized soft washes echoing
  // the menu's water palette; body::before drifts them on a slow loop so the
  // bright field reads as a living degradê rather than flat white. Kept far
  // below text contrast (AAA audit measures --bg-primary, this never paints
  // over text surfaces directly — body content stays on the flat field).
  --bg-glow:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 55% 45% at 18% 22%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--menu-bg) 70%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 50% 40% at 82% 78%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--menu-ink-2) 14%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 40% 55% at 55% 45%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 85%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 70%
    );

  // Card shadow tokens — light theme: elevated shadows show card lift clearly
  // with a subtle hairline shadow border
  --shadow-card: 0 0 0 0.0625rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06), 0 0.125rem 0.75rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  --shadow-card-featured: 0 0 0 0.0625rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 0.5rem 1.75rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
  --shadow-card-hover: 0 0 0 0.0625rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15), 0 1.25rem 3.125rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);

  --white: #ffffff;
  --black: #262626;
  --grey: #a79e9e;
  --grey-2: #f0f0f0;
  --grey-3: #515151;
  --blue: #{$color-blue};

  // Skeleton shades sit close to real surfaces; dark containers redeclare
  // them via %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE so tiles lift the local dark tone.
  --skel-ink: var(--text-primary);
  --skel-bg-1: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 93%, var(--bg-dark) 7%);
  --skel-bg-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 83%, var(--bg-dark) 17%);
  --skel-bg-3: var(--skel-bg-1);
  // One line box of the element the skeleton stands in for (resolves at the usage site)
  --skel-line: 1lh;

  // Spacing tokens (Fibonacci scale, unitless — multiply with rem in CSS)
  --space-none: #{$space-none};
  --space-hairline: #{$space-hairline};
  --space-pixel: #{$space-pixel};
  --space-3xs: #{$space-3xs};
  --space-2xs: #{$space-2xs};
  --space-xs: #{$space-xs};
  --space-sm: #{$space-sm};
  --space-md: #{$space-md};
  --space-lg: #{$space-lg};
  --space-xl: #{$space-xl};
  --space-2xl: #{$space-2xl};
  --space-3xl: #{$space-3xl};
  --space-4xl: #{$space-4xl};
  --space-5xl: #{$space-5xl};
  --space-6xl: #{$space-6xl};
  --space-7xl: #{$space-7xl};
  --space-8xl: #{$space-8xl};
  --space-9xl: #{$space-9xl};
  --space-10xl: #{$space-10xl};

  // Border radius tokens
  --radius-none: 0;
  --radius-hairline: #{to-rem($space-hairline)};
  --radius-2xs: #{to-rem($space-2xs)};
  --radius-xs: #{to-rem($space-xs)};
  --radius-sm: #{to-rem($space-sm)};
  --radius-md: #{to-rem($space-md)};
  --radius-lg: #{to-rem($space-lg)};
  --radius-xl: #{to-rem($space-xl)};
  --radius-full: 50%;
  --radius-round: 9999px;

  // Z-index layering system \u2014 exposed from $z-* SCSS tokens
  --z-overlay: #{$z-overlay};
  --z-hud: #{$z-hud};
  --z-modal: #{$z-modal};
  --z-cookies: #{$z-cookies};
  --z-nav: #{$z-nav};
  --z-top: #{$z-top};

  // Consent-banner live height — CookieBanner writes the real px value on
  // documentElement while visible and removes it when dismissed; the 0px
  // default keeps `main` unpadded when no banner is up.
  --cookie-banner-h: 0px;

  // Font stacks
  --font-mono: #{$font-mono};
  --font-primary: 'Raleway', sans-serif;

  /* Abbreviated CSS custom property mappings for optimized footprint */
  /* --bg-primary -> --bg-1 */
  --bg-1: var(--bg-primary);
  /* --bg-secondary -> --bg-2 */
  --bg-2: var(--bg-secondary);
  /* --bg-dark -> --bg-d */
  --bg-d: var(--bg-dark);
  /* --bg-darker -> --bg-dr */
  --bg-dr: var(--bg-darker);
  /* --text-primary -> --tx-1 */
  --tx-1: var(--text-primary);
  /* --text-secondary -> --tx-2 */
  --tx-2: var(--text-secondary);
  /* --text-muted -> --tx-m */
  --tx-m: var(--text-muted);
  /* --border-color -> --bd-c */
  --bd-c: var(--border-color);
  /* --space-xs -> --sp-xs */
  --sp-xs: var(--space-xs);
  /* --space-sm -> --sp-sm */
  --sp-sm: var(--space-sm);
  /* --space-md -> --sp-md */
  --sp-md: var(--space-md);
  /* --space-lg -> --sp-lg */
  --sp-lg: var(--space-lg);
  /* --space-xl -> --sp-xl */
  --sp-xl: var(--space-xl);
  /* --radius-sm -> --r-sm */
  --r-sm: var(--radius-sm);
  /* --radius-md -> --r-md */
  --r-md: var(--radius-md);
  --filament-glow: none;
  --metallic-hairline: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 20%,
    rgba(55, 167, 212, 0.45) 50%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 80%,
    transparent 100%
  );
}

// Dark theme token overrides — flips all --bg-*/--text-*/--menu-* vars when .dark-mode is on <html>.
html.dark-mode {
  color-scheme: dark;

  --bg-primary: #000000;
  --bg-secondary: #030302;
  --bg-dark: #040404;
  --bg-dark-alpha: #{rgba($color-black, 0.92)};
  --bg-darker: #1e1d1d;
  --bg-darkest: #020202;
  --text-primary: #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: #e2e8f0;
  --text-muted: #b8b1ac;
  --border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  --color-accent-contrast: #{$cms-accent};
  --btn-accent-fill: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  --glass-bg: rgba(11, 12, 16, 0.92);

  // Menu inks resolve to the current monochrome field — identical rendering.
  --menu-bg: var(--bg-darkest);
  --menu-ink: var(--text-primary);
  --menu-ink-2: var(--text-primary);

  --filament-glow: radial-gradient(
    circle at 50% 30%,
    rgba(95, 218, 255, 0.05) 0%,
    rgba(40, 244, 255, 0.015) 50%,
    transparent 80%
  );

  // Dark variant of the animated page backdrop — deep-water glows matching
  // the filament palette, kept just above --bg-primary so the field shifts
  // without lighting the canvas.
  --bg-glow:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 18% 22%, rgba(95, 218, 255, 0.04) 0%, transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 82% 78%, rgba(40, 244, 255, 0.025) 0%, transparent 70%);
  --metallic-hairline: linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    transparent 0%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 20%,
    rgba(55, 167, 212, 0.45) 50%,
    rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 80%,
    transparent 100%
  );

  // Dark mode: subtle shadow border highlights card and cover boundaries on pitch black
  --shadow-card: 0 0 0 0.0625rem rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), 0 0.125rem 1rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
  --shadow-card-featured:
    0 0 0 0.0625rem rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 0.5rem 2rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
  --shadow-card-hover:
    0 0 0 0.0625rem rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28), 0 1.25rem 3.125rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);

  --white: #0a0b10;
  --black: #ffffff;
  --grey: #b2b4b7;
  --grey-2: #abacac;
  --grey-3: #cbd5e1;

  --skel-ink: var(--text-primary);
  --skel-bg-1: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 93%, var(--color-white-raw) 7%);
  --skel-bg-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-secondary) 83%, var(--color-white-raw) 17%);
  --skel-bg-3: var(--skel-bg-1);
}

// Page base styles (html then html.dark-mode overrides below).
html {
  color-scheme: light;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: scroll; // always show scrollbar to prevent layout shift on navigation
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;

  // Native browser scrollbar theme — inherits from color-scheme
  scrollbar-color: var(--border-color) transparent;
  scrollbar-width: thin;
}

// Scroll-lock applied while a modal is open (JS toggles this class).
html.modal-open {
  overflow-y: hidden; // hide background scrollbar when any modal is open
}

// Document body base: bg-primary fill, text-primary ink, primary font.
body {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  // An unbreakable title word (long compound locales) must never push the
  // page wider than the viewport — clip it at the body edge so no
  // horizontal scrollbar appears and full-bleed backgrounds stay aligned.
  overflow-x: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg-primary);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  transition:
    background-color 0.3s ease,
    color 0.3s ease;

  // Never break words mid-character anywhere in the site.
  // Words always wrap whole to the next line.
  word-break: normal;
  overflow-wrap: normal; // never split a word across lines — wrap entire words only
  hyphens: none; // no automatic hyphenation

  // The animated degradê backdrop: a fixed, oversized wash layer behind all
  // content (z-index -1 keeps it above the body's own background but below
  // every child). Transform-only animation → pure compositor, no repaints.
  // The -25% inset oversizes the layer so the drift never exposes an edge.
  &::before {
    content: '';
    position: fixed;
    inset: -25%;
    z-index: -1;
    background: var(--bg-glow);
    animation: body-glow-drift 46s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
}

// Slow drift path — three poses on alternate so the loop reads as an
// endless wander rather than a ping-pong between two corners.
@keyframes body-glow-drift {
  0% {
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1);
  }

  50% {
    transform: translate3d(2.5%, -2%, 0) scale(1.06);
  }

  100% {
    transform: translate3d(-2%, 2.5%, 0) scale(1.03);
  }
}

// App mount point — fills the viewport.
#app {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  background: transparent;
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 100vh;
}

q,
h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6,
p,
span,
a,
label,
ul,
ol,
figure,
video,
image,
iframe,
picture,
blockquote {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

ul,
ol {
  list-style: none;
}

a {
  font-size: 100%;
  vertical-align: baseline;
  background: transparent;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

button {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
}

app-root,
view-home,
view-project,
view-legal,
view-not-found,
view-admin-login,
view-cms-dashboard,
app-nav,
home-mosaic,
about-section,
contact-section,
awards-mentions,
awards-carousel,
custom-carousel,
preferences-modal,
lang-dialog,
cookie-banner,
portfolio-related,
media-figure,
media-expanded {
  display: block;
}

draw-text {
  display: inline;
}

// Routed content host (#main).
main {
  // Clearance for the fixed cookie banner — without it the banner covers
  // the page bottom (legal footer unreachable) until consent is answered.
  padding-bottom: var(--cookie-banner-h);

  .modal-open & {
    position: fixed;
    top: var(
      --modal-top,
      0px
    ); // Set via JS before class toggle — prevents iOS Safari scroll-to-top
    width: 100%;
    left: 0;
  }
}

#main {
  min-height: 100vh;
}

// Section markers the nav's scroll tracker measures (#about/#contact offsets).
#home,
#about,
#contact {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// Home section top anchor.
#home {
  @include layout-1024() {
    min-height: 100vh;
  }
}

// ── Global Skeleton Utilities ────────────────────────────────────────────────
@keyframes skeleton-shimmer {
  0% {
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  100% {
    transform: translateX(100%);
  }
}

// Skeleton placeholder surface + shimmer — driven entirely by CSS (no JS loop; the old rAF version froze iOS).
.skeleton {
  &--shimmer,
  &-cover,
  &-placeholder {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--skel-bg-1);
    color: transparent;
    user-select: none;

    &::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(
        105deg,
        transparent 30%,
        var(--skel-bg-2) 45%,
        var(--skel-bg-2) 55%,
        transparent 70%
      );
      transform: translateX(-100%);
      animation: skeleton-shimmer 1.8s linear infinite;
      will-change: transform;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
  }

  &--title {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    width: 45%;
    max-width: to-rem(480);
    height: to-rem(24);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-md);

    @include layout-768() {
      height: to-rem(36);
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      height: to-rem(56);
    }
  }

  &--hero {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    display: block;
  }

  &--media {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: to-rem(200);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    display: block;
  }

  &--text-block {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: to-rem($space-sm);
    width: 100%;
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) 0;
  }

  &--text-line {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    height: to-rem(18);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);

    @include layout-768() {
      height: to-rem(21);
    }
  }

  &--tag {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: to-rem(110);
    height: to-rem(36);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  &--title-sm {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: 35%;
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--title-md {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: 45%;
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--section-title {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 55%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 2);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-full {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 3);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-94 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 94%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 2);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-98 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 98%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 3);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--para-65 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 65%;
    height: calc(var(--skel-line) * 2);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &--badge {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: to-rem($space-3xl);
    height: to-rem($space-3xl);
    border-radius: 50%;
    margin: 0 to-rem($space-md);
  }

  &--footer-link {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: inline-block;
    width: to-rem($space-3xl);
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-hairline);
  }

  &--footer-note-1 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 90%;
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
    margin-top: to-rem($space-lg);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &--footer-note-2 {
    @extend .skeleton--shimmer;
    display: block;
    width: 75%;
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    border-radius: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  // WebGL glyph field: absolutely-positioned overlay above the placeholders,
  // sized + translated inline by SkeletonWebGL. Content stays interactive.
  &-layer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;

    // While resolving, the incoming content owns the foreground: the layer
    // sinks below it so stale placeholder geometry never paints over real
    // data — the dissolve is only visible through still-transparent areas.
    &--resolving {
      z-index: -1;
    }
  }

  // Content arriving under a resolving layer fades in while glyphs collapse.
  // The class lands on the [data-content] wrapper (display: contents), so the
  // animation must target its children to be visible.
  &-content-in > * {
    animation: skeleton-content-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }
}

// The canvas is a direct child of the shadow root: anchor its containing
// block to the host while a layer is active. The placeholders remain in flow
// so their geometry can still be measured, but become transparent because the
// WebGL canvas already paints those exact rectangles. Leaving the CSS shimmer
// visible underneath produces two superimposed skeleton animations everywhere.
:host(.has-skeleton-layer) {
  position: relative;
  // Confine the layer's stacking to this host so the resolving z-index: -1
  // drops under this component's content only — never behind page siblings.
  isolation: isolate;

  [data-content] [class*='skeleton'] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

@keyframes skeleton-content-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// ── Keyboard focus ring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Emitted here so it lands in the document AND inside every component shadow
// root that imports this file — :focus-visible fires for keyboard focus only,
// so mouse users never see the ring.
@include focus-ring-scope;
